extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: Halloween has company: spiders scuttling across the screen, fast and slow, one now and then letting itself down a thread; a witch on her broomstick crossing the sky; and ghosts drifting past. The red tint over your background stays as it was, and Devil's Night is unchanged. The first time each year that Halloween comes on by itself, it starts with the red tint alone. After a while a spider shoots across, then another, then the witch, and it builds up from there, the fog rolling in and the lightning starting, until after about half an hour all of it is running. Every other time, after a restart or with the theme picked by hand, it starts with everything at once.
